auth.welcome: Sign in to reach your teams, projects and tasks.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.hint: Drag a card's handle to rearrange the board.

projects.title: Projects
projects.name: Name
projects.emptyBody: Create the first project to start organising the team's work.

task.title: Title
task.assigneesHint: One person can be on several projects and tasks.
task.deleteBody: This task and all of its sub-tasks will be removed. This cannot be undone.
task.timerAlreadyRunning: You already have a timer running. Stop it first.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.dropHint: or drag them here. Up to {{limit}} per file.
attachments.attachToComment: Attach a file to this comment
attachments.commentUploadFailed: The comment was posted, but the files could not be attached to it. Add them to the task instead.
attachments.unavailable: File attachments are not available: this installation has no object storage configured.

myTasks.title: My tasks
myTasks.emptyBody: When someone assigns you to a task, it shows up here.

teams.title: Teams
teams.name: Name
teams.emptyBody: Create a team to group the people who work together.
teams.noMembers: Nobody is on this team yet.
teams.searchPeople: Search people by name, e-mail or username...
teams.keepTyping: Keep typing — at least two characters.
teams.directoryUnavailable: Active Directory could not be searched, so only people who already have an account are listed. Configure the directory and its service account under Administration → System settings.
teams.createLocallyHint: Somebody who is not in the directory can be given a local account under Administration → Users.

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.privateHint: Visible only to members of the space.
spaces.emptyBody: Spaces organise work by department, client or initiative.

resources.title: Resource allocation
resources.emptyBody: Assign people to tasks to track their workload.

chat.title: Internal chat
chat.emptyBody: Be the first to write in this channel.
chat.noChannelBody: Pick a channel on the left to read its messages.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sessionsHint: Where your account is signed in. End any session you do not recognise.
settings.notificationsHint: Choose how each kind of alert reaches you. Anything you switch off stops being sent — the digest still gathers whatever was held back.
settings.digestHint: Gathers into one message whatever was not sent immediately.
settings.capacityHint: How many hours a week you are available for. Capacity planning compares allocated work against this number.
settings.privacyHint: Download everything the system holds about you. Erasure is irreversible and sits with an administrator.
settings.serviceTokensHint: Machine credentials for SCIM provisioning and read-only reporting. Only the hash is stored.
settings.tokenShownOnce: Copy it now: this secret is never shown again.
settings.passwordHint: The current password is required even for administrators. Changing it ends every other session you have open.
settings.passwordManagedByAD: This account signs in through Active Directory; its password is managed there.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions have been ended.

errors.genericBody: The operation could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.networkBody: Check your connection and try again.
errors.notFoundBody: The item you are looking for does not exist or was removed.
errors.forbiddenBody: You do not have permission to view or change this item.
errors.boundaryBody: This page stopped working. Reloading usually fixes it.

views.label: Views
views.timelineEmptyBody: Give tasks a start and due date to see them on the timeline.

docs.title: Docs
docs.hint: Notes, decisions and reference material, written in Markdown. Every save keeps the previous version.
docs.emptyBody: Create the first document in this space.

goals.title: Goals and OKRs
goals.hint: Objectives and the key results that measure them. A measure can be read straight from the tasks, so a goal cannot drift from the work.
goals.name: Name
goals.spaceHint: Leave empty for an organisation-wide goal.
goals.emptyBody: State the first objective and how it will be measured.
goals.noMeasures: No key results. A goal without a measure is an intention.
goals.measureSourceHint: Manual is yours to update; the others are read from the project tasks.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.hint: Every project at once: health, progress, and whether the people are over-committed.
portfolio.restrictedBody: The portfolio names every project and its health, so only managers and administrators can open it.
portfolio.capacityHint: Committed hours against the hours each person actually has. A task estimate is shared between its assignees.
portfolio.earnedValueHint: Measured against the approved baseline, in hours. The system holds estimates and tracked time but no rates — inventing one would produce a number that looks authoritative and is not.
portfolio.baselineFailed: The baseline could not be captured
portfolio.noBaselineBody: Without an approved plan there is nothing to measure against. Capture a baseline to start.

admin.title: System settings
admin.hint: Integrations an administrator can change without a redeploy. Changes take effect immediately — no restart needed.
admin.restrictedBody: These settings decide who may sign in and where e-mail goes. Only administrators can read or change them.
admin.mirrorOn: Mirrored to {{path}}. The database is authoritative; the file is for backup and review.
admin.mirrorOff: File mirroring is off. Set SETTINGS_ENV_FILE to enable it.
admin.groupHint_ad: Authentication against the company directory. Local accounts keep working.
admin.groupHint_smtp: Used for deadline alerts, assignments and digests. Switched off, messages go to the log.
admin.groupHint_oidc: Sign in through an identity provider. Register the redirect URL with the provider exactly as written here.
admin.groupHint_alerts: How many days before a due date each assignee is warned.
admin.groupHint_retention: Zero keeps everything. Unread notifications are never expired.
admin.testHint: Sends a real message with the settings in force. Save before testing.
admin.testAdHint: Tries a bind against the directory. The credentials are used for this attempt only and are never stored.
admin.groupHint_ai: An OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Point it at a hosted provider or at your own inference server — an address and port is enough; the protocol and the /v1 path are filled in for you. Leave the model name empty and it is detected from the endpoint itself. Used to suggest a priority and an assignee on intake submissions; a person applies the suggestion, nothing is changed automatically.
admin.testAiHint: Sends one short prompt with the settings in force.
admin.testAiDetected: {{model}} answered — chosen automatically from {{count}} the endpoint offers.

users.title: Users
users.hint: Accounts, roles and access. An administrator can promote, demote, deactivate and reset passwords.
users.restrictedBody: Only administrators can manage accounts and roles.
users.newHint: The account is created with the role you choose. The person signs in with the password set here.
users.search: Search by name, username or e-mail
users.name: Name
users.roleHint: Administrator manages accounts and system settings. Manager runs projects and spaces. Member works on tasks.
users.usernameHint: What the person types to sign in. With AD enabled, use the same name as the directory.
users.resetHint: The person signs in with the new password immediately. Every session they have open is ended.
users.singleAdminWarning: There is only one active administrator. Promote somebody else before demoting or deactivating this account — the system refuses the change that would leave nobody administering.
users.resetOwnHint: This is your own account, so the current password is required — being an administrator does not prove you are the one at the keyboard. Your other sessions will be ended.

recurrence.title: Repeats
recurrence.mode_on_complete_hint: Nothing piles up. If nobody finishes it, nothing comes next.
recurrence.mode_on_schedule_hint: An unfinished one stays open and goes overdue, so a neglected series looks neglected.

templates.willCreate: The template also creates its status columns and its tasks, dated from today.

intake.title: Intake
intake.hint: Forms people fill in to ask for work. A submission becomes an ordinary task on this project.
intake.noFormsBody: A form lets somebody raise work without knowing how this board is organised.
intake.allowAnonymousHint: Anyone with the address can submit without signing in.
intake.publicAddressHint: The address is the secret. Anyone who has it can submit.
intake.confirmDelete: Delete this form? Submissions already received keep their tasks.
intake.noSubmissions: Nothing has come in through this form yet.

canvas.whiteboardsHint: A surface for the thinking that happens before there are tasks.
canvas.noBoardsBody: A board holds notes, shapes and arrows — the shape of an idea before it is work.
canvas.noProjects: Create a project first: a board belongs to one.
canvas.confirmDeleteBoard: Delete this board? It cannot be recovered.
canvas.boardHint: Pick a tool, then click the canvas. Double-click a note to write in it.
canvas.conflict: Somebody else saved this board while you were editing. Reopen it to see their version.

clips.title: Clips
clips.hint: Record your screen and keep it with the work it is about.
clips.unsupported: This browser cannot record a screen.
clips.noneBody: A recording explains in twenty seconds what a paragraph does badly.
clips.confirmDelete: Delete this clip? The recording is removed from storage too.

sheets.title: Sheets
sheets.hint: Numbers kept beside the work they describe, instead of in an attachment.
sheets.noneBody: A column of numbers with a total under it, without leaving the project.
sheets.confirmDelete: Delete this sheet? It cannot be recovered.
sheets.conflict: Somebody else saved this sheet while you were editing. Reopen it to see their version.

apps.title: Apps
apps.hint: What this installation is connected to, and what it could be.
apps.adBody: Sign in with company credentials, and find colleagues in the directory when staffing a team.
apps.smtpBody: Deadline alerts and digests, sent through your own mail server.
apps.oidcBody: Any OpenID Connect provider. Endpoints are discovered from the issuer.
apps.aiBody: An OpenAI-compatible endpoint, used to suggest a priority and an assignee on requests.
apps.storageBody: S3-compatible object storage, holding attachments and clips.
apps.webhooksBody: Service tokens for scripts and other systems that need to read or write here.
apps.moreTitle: Why there is no app store here
apps.moreBody: A catalogue implies outside developers publishing to it. This is an internal tool, so what would fill one is the list above: the systems your organisation already runs. Anything else is reached through the API with a service token.
